title: Working from Home for the First Time
paragraphs: Saat perusahaannya beralih ke kerja jarak jauh, Salim mula-mula bekerja dari tempat tidur. Setelah satu minggu, ia melihat bahwa hal itu membuatnya sulit fokus. Ia membeli meja sederhana dan kursi yang nyaman. Ia juga memberi tahu keluarganya kapan ia membutuhkan waktu tenang untuk bekerja.

Panggilan video membutuhkan latihan. Suatu kali, Salim lupa mematikan mikrofon saat keluarganya membahas makan siang di dekatnya. Setelah sebulan, ruang kerjanya di rumah terasa lebih profesional. Ia belajar bahwa kebiasaan baik sama pentingnya dengan teknologi.
answerKey: When his company moved to remote work, Salim first worked from his bed. After one week, he saw that this made it hard to focus. He bought a simple desk and a comfortable chair. He also told his family when he needed quiet time for work. Video calls took practice. Once, Salim forgot to mute his microphone while his family discussed lunch nearby. After a month, his home office felt more professional. He learned that good habits mattered as much as the technology.
